description: Recipient-side L1 Quad per ADR-2605282200 — CACAO-signed by a potential recipient DID expressing an interest in receiving a particular stable on a particular pair. The match engine (Pregel cell kawase_pool_match) joins deposits against open withdrawIntents to find counter-flows that obviate the need for an on-chain DEX rebalance. WithdrawIntents are advisory (not binding); a deposit may still settle via reserve buffer if no matching intent is open at match epoch.

recipientDid.description: DID of the adherent willing to be matched on this pair (i.e., to deposit srcStable in exchange for receiving tgtStable from a counter-deposit). Recipient MUST hold Adherent SBT per G3.

minSrcAmountMinor.description: Smallest deposit (in srcStable minor units) the recipient is willing to match against. Default: full pool floor.

maxSrcAmountMinor.description: Largest deposit (in srcStable minor units) the recipient is willing to match against. Must NOT exceed recipient's own per-month cap (G9).

validUntil.description: Intent expiry. After this instant the match engine will not consider this intent. Default: createdAt + 30 days.
